title: Replication package: How Reliable Is Machine Learning for Anticipating Vulnerability Disclosures in Software Dependencies? A Temporal Evaluation Against Libyear and Package-History Baselines
description: Dataset, fixed source data, code, per-instance predictions and results for a temporal evaluation of machine learning for anticipating vulnerability disclosures in npm dependencies (29,379 direct-dependency instances from 238 GitHub JavaScript projects, year-end snapshots 2020-2023, labels from GitHub Security Advisories). See README.md for contents, environment and rerun instructions.
